name: How long does cabin interior sealing usually take, and when should I schedule it?

mainEntity.name: How long does cabin interior sealing usually take, and when should I schedule it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timing depends on the size of the cabin and how many problem areas are exposed, but many projects can be completed in a day once access is clear. If the work is part of a larger interior restoration or winter prep project, scheduling before the first cold snap is usually the most practical choice in the Denver metro area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most small to midsize interior sealing jobs can be done in a day, but larger cabins or ones with hidden damage take longer. The best time to schedule is before heavy heating season or right after you notice new gaps.
